lines.6: 「Left her behind. She wouldn't wake up.」
lines.9: We exchange a little small talk.
lines.10: 「...I always wonder, isn't that thing over your shoulders hot?」
lines.12: 「So I like warm things. My room is decorated in a tropical style too.」
lines.13: 「Is that why your hair is so long? It kind of makes you look like a shrimp...」
lines.15: That seems to have hurt her a little.
lines.17: Strange. Why does talking to Sato make me want to tease her just a little?
lines.20: She hits me with her folded mountain bike.
lines.21: 「I don't know what this is about, but if you bully my friend Yoppi, I'll erase you from society.」
lines.22: 「First I'll frame your father for corporate misconduct and get him fired.」
lines.24: 「You bully her all the time yourself.」
lines.31: Blood is seeping from my temple where the mountain bike hit me.
lines.32: The Princess never holds back with her retorts...
lines.33: 「A badge of honor for a rambunctious boy.」
lines.34: She says it with a smile and walks away without apologizing.
lines.35: 「Oh, I'm sorry... Ellie hit you pretty hard.」
lines.36: Sato takes out one of the adhesive bandages she carries.
lines.38: 「Yeah. I'm a little clumsy, so I get minor injuries pretty often...」
lines.39: 「Oh, I can kind of see that.」
lines.40: 「Ugh... Hearing you agree makes me feel complicated.」
lines.41: Despite her complaint, Sato gently tends to me.
lines.42: 「Good... It doesn't look like much of an injury. I'm really sorry.」
lines.43: She softly strokes the wound through the bandage.
lines.44: 「You have it rough too, looking after the Princess.」
lines.47: Talking to Sato really does calm me down.
lines.48: Maybe she's what you'd call the healing type.
lines.49: For some reason, I tend to attract hot-blooded women.
lines.51: The looks from everyone walking around us feel strangely painful.
lines.56: 「I'm not even Igaguri anymore? At least say the whole name.」
lines.57: 「Don't crowd me! You're making it hotter!」
lines.59: 「You and Sato aren't dating, are you?」
lines.61: 「Yeah, figured. But people say it kind of looks that way from the outside.」
lines.63: Crab and I do get mistaken for a couple sometimes...
lines.64: 「But Sato is nice to everyone. I'm not anyone special.」
lines.65: 「Some say she's especially nice to you... Ah, well. If you aren't dating, that's all I needed.」
lines.66: 「You and me have kind of overlapping character types. It ain't fair if only you get popular.」
lines.67: 「What part of our characters overlaps? I'll seriously kill you.」
lines.68: 「Still, I guess she really is popular.」
lines.69: 「Who wouldn't like a sweet, cute girl who's good at housework and looks like she'd devote herself to you?」
lines.71: And so class representative Yoshimi Sato was wildly popular.
